newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia tycoon makes offer for Uniphoenix.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia tycoon makes offer for Uniphoenix.

text.p: Malaysian tycoon Soh Chee Wen will make a mandatory general offer for the entire stake in Uniphoenix Corporation Bhd not under his control, Uniphoenix said in a statement.
It said Soh has acquired 80.70 million shares in the company taking his stake to 72.35 percent of the total equity.
"Under the Malaysian Code of Take-Overs and Mergers, Soh Chee Wen is required to serve a Notice of Take-Over," it said.
Meanwhile, Soh has been appointed managing director and chief executive officer of Uniphoenix from July 24, the stockbroking and real estate company said in a separate statement.
